evidence: Official API docs state the no-key demo and Free access expose 5 days of equity NBBO quote tapes from the same warehouse, with SIP timestamps and CTA/UTP lineage.

Official Terms and API docs describe market data as delayed, generally current only to approximately the prior trading day; trade-tape coverage is current to the prior session with a one-to-two-day ingest lag.
The public product page explicitly labels Free MCP as 15-minute delayed stocks and T+1 options.
Tick-level equity trades (`stocks_trades`) are a paid-tier dataset; the no-key demo explicitly says no tick trades.

Terms §4.4 says market data comes from third-party exchanges/SIPs/OPRA and use remains subject to those providers' rules. Automated extraction through the programmatic API is allowed, but this does not convert delayed/free data into a lawful live non-display entitlement.
reopen_condition: Free/MCP must provide same-run RTH realtime consolidated NBBO plus a free latest-trade event with independent event timestamp under explicit permanent-$0 automated/non-display rights; delayed or prior-session warehouse data remains non-G9.
